newsitem.title: USA: US Fax, Future complete shr swap.
newsitem.headline: US Fax, Future complete shr swap.

text.p: US Fax Inc said Friday it completed the exchange of all the shares of common stock of its wholly-owned subsidiary Superior Tek Inc with 10 million shares of Future Success Software Corp.

The company said the previously-announced deal was initially intended to be an exchange of assets, but for legal and other considerations, it was finalized as an exchange for shares of Future's Success's stock.
US Fax also said it will distribute the shares of Future Success received in the deal to stockholders of record on Sept. 30,
The company said the distribution should occur early in October.
As a result of the transaction, US Fax will own about 90 percent of the outstanding shares of Future Success.
Superior Tek will be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Future Success.
US Fax said Future Sucess had no significant business or operations prior to the transaction.
The company said the deal allows Superior to operate and finance its holographic business as a "stand-alone" company.
